NHÀ HÀNG MÓN HUẾ is the worst place to try Hue's (the old capital) food. WORST EXPERIENCE EVER. AVOID
Jun 2016 • Friends
Before I get into this, I want to specify that this review is for the Mon Hue restaurant located in District 1 at 201 De Tham Street, close to the Go2 Bar. I haven't been to any other Mon Hue restaurants, and I definitely won't based on the terrible experience I and my friends received here.

We were lured in by the professional look of the place, and since it' a chain, we figured the food would be safe, which it was. However, the service was extremely incompetent and slow.

When we finally got our order, we finished and were waiting for the appetizer my friend ordered. Some spring rolls. We got everything except the starter we asked for. The server brought over our bill and we saw that the spring rolls we hadn't received were being charged for.

We brought this to her attention and she walked away, then came back saying that they were almost done. We waited a bit longer, giving up on the spring rolls and asked to pay our bill so we could get on with our day. She then told us that we had received our spring rolls. No. We had not. A heated argument ensued. We would not be paying for something we did not receive. This went on for a good 20 minutes when the server (in between laughing) insisted that we had received the spring rolls, which only moments before, she had said were almost done. After this, she said they would finally be making our spring rolls, but it would take about 10 minutes. We said ok fine, and paid up.

We sat there seething and frustrated for over 15 minutes and decided to leave. I really don't care if I have bad service. I've been around long enough to not take it seriously, but this place was absolutely repulsive. There's bad service, and there's incompetent service that accuses you of lying. It went from "the spring rolls are being made" to "you already got the spring rolls" to "ok we'll start making your spring rolls now".

I can't express the level of frustration in this experience. Everyone in the place was staring at the shouting match and i'm glad. The more people that know how terrible this place is the better.

Skip this place if you want to enjoy your stay in Saigon. There are way better places around that are family run that actually take pride in what they do. Mon Hue is a shameful excuse for a restaurant. I want to say that I'm happy that this is not a place that represents Vietnam. I've had great service and amazing food just about everywhere else I've been in this country, with the exception of Mon Hue.

There are now several locations to this local chain, and quality/consistency can vary from location to location. That being said, my wife and I eat here on a semi-regular basis.
